customer_message.subject: Notice of termination received – Allmendstrasse 61, Kriens
customer_message.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

On 12 August I received a written notice of termination from Verwaltung Emme & Söhne for our 5.5-room flat at Allmendstrasse 61 in Kriens, with effect from 31 July 2027.

The notice refers to the CHF 6570 we owe, three months that we were unable to pay after my business closed. We have since agreed a repayment plan with the debt advice centre, but the management did not want to know.

What strikes me is the timing: only last month I was the one who collected signatures from all the tenants about the dangerous balcony railings and sent them to the management and the town. Funny that our family is the first one to go.

We have three children at the local school, the youngest has special needs and depends on the support teacher there. Finding a flat for four people in Kriens by next summer is impossible. We will definitely need an extension if the termination is upheld.

Can you help us challenge the termination and request an extension?

Kind regards,
Arjun Kowalczyk
